theorems.name: Submission.frt_hausdorff_density_one_of_flat_covers
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), μHE[n] A ≠ ∞ → NullMeasurableSet A μHE[n] → (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∃ C : Set (Grassmannian N n × Set (Euclidean N)), C.Countable ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, IsClosed c.2 ∧ ∀ y ∈ c.2, ∀ z ∈ c.2, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖) ∧ A ⊆ ⋃ c ∈ C, c.2) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A, HasDensity n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A) x 1
